name: Streaming User Matching Pipeline
description: Streaming pipeline that processes Marriage AI profile updates, scoring evidence, reranks candidates, and writes match results.

parameters.name: project
parameters.label: Project ID
parameters.helpText: GCP project ID for Dataflow and Google Cloud resources.

parameters.name: region
parameters.label: Dataflow Region
parameters.helpText: GCP region for the Dataflow job.

parameters.name: runner
parameters.label: Beam Runner
parameters.helpText: Beam runner to use, usually DataflowRunner for production.

parameters.name: temp_location
parameters.label: Temp Location
parameters.helpText: GCS path for temporary Dataflow files, e.g. gs://bucket/dataflow/streaming/temp.

parameters.name: staging_location
parameters.label: Staging Location
parameters.helpText: GCS path for staged Dataflow files, e.g. gs://bucket/dataflow/streaming/staging.

parameters.name: service_account_email
parameters.label: Worker Service Account
parameters.helpText: Service account email used by Dataflow workers.

parameters.name: requirements_file
parameters.label: Requirements File
parameters.helpText: Path to requirements.txt inside the Flex Template image.

parameters.name: user_profile_updated_pubsub_topic
parameters.label: Immediate Profile Update Pub/Sub Topic
parameters.helpText: Full Pub/Sub topic path for immediate QA/profile update events.

parameters.name: delayed_matching_pubsub_topic
parameters.label: Delayed Matching Pub/Sub Topic
parameters.helpText: Full Pub/Sub topic path for delayed matching events.

parameters.name: pinecone_index
parameters.label: Pinecone Index
parameters.helpText: Name of the Pinecone index containing profile statement embeddings.

parameters.name: pinecone_region
parameters.label: Pinecone Region
parameters.helpText: Pinecone region/environment, e.g. us-west1-gcp.

parameters.name: pdf_bucket
parameters.label: Instructions PDF Bucket
parameters.helpText: GCS bucket containing the AI instructions PDF used by reranking.

parameters.name: notification_function_url
parameters.label: Notification Function URL
parameters.helpText: HTTPS URL for match notification Cloud Function/Cloud Run service.

parameters.name: voice_agent_function_url
parameters.label: Voice Agent Function URL
parameters.helpText: HTTPS URL for voice-agent action Cloud Function/Cloud Run service.

parameters.name: dlq_gcs_path
parameters.label: DLQ GCS Path
parameters.helpText: GCS path prefix for dead-letter records, e.g. gs://bucket/dataflow/streaming/dlq/.

parameters.name: top_k
parameters.label: Top K Vector Candidates
parameters.helpText: Number of nearest-neighbor candidates queried from Pinecone per statement.

parameters.name: rerank_top_n
parameters.label: Rerank Top N
parameters.helpText: Number of top scoreboard candidates to rerank with the AI reranker.

parameters.name: pdf_instructions_path
parameters.label: Instructions PDF Path
parameters.helpText: Path inside the PDF bucket for AI reranking instructions.

parameters.name: weight_preference_fulfillment
parameters.label: Preference Fulfillment Weight
parameters.helpText: Scoreboard weight for applicant/preference fulfillment evidence.

parameters.name: weight_attribute_similarity
parameters.label: Attribute Similarity Weight
parameters.helpText: Scoreboard weight for attribute similarity evidence.

parameters.name: tasks_location
parameters.label: Cloud Tasks Location
parameters.helpText: Region/location for Cloud Tasks queues.

parameters.name: delayed_matching_queue
parameters.label: Delayed Matching Queue
parameters.helpText: Cloud Tasks queue name for delayed matching.

parameters.name: notification_queue
parameters.label: Notification Queue
parameters.helpText: Cloud Tasks queue name for match notifications.

parameters.name: voice_agent_queue
parameters.label: Voice Agent Queue
parameters.helpText: Cloud Tasks queue name for voice-agent calls.

parameters.name: delayed_task_delay_seconds
parameters.label: Delayed Task Delay Seconds
parameters.helpText: Delay before scheduling delayed matching tasks.
